name: axwise
description: Product discovery, saved personas, simulated interviews, evidence analysis, PRDs and delivery briefs through the Rust AxWise specialist and your current Codex model.

interface.longDescription: Scope a product, build a saved stakeholder cohort, explore explicitly requested interview simulations, analyze exact evidence and create a traceable PRD. Rust validates, reviews, renders and saves each artifact while Codex supplies model access. This local edition bundles the Apple Silicon macOS AxWise 0.5.2 executable.
defaultPrompt: Use AxWise for the complete flow: scope, personas, simulated interviews, analysis and a launch PRD.
Use AxWise to analyze these real interview transcripts and turn the findings into a PRD.
Use AxWise to create an engineering delivery brief from this saved PRD.
